subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding the unit circle and defining sine and cosine for any angle
source_inspiration: adapted from Japan MEXT Courses of Study sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student rotates a physical radius marker around a unit circle model and reads off coordinate values
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an angle on the unit circle to its correct sine and cosine coordinate values
exercise.abstract: Student finds the sine and cosine of a given angle using the unit circle

misconception_flags: confuses which coordinate (x or y) represents cosine versus sine

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
